That commit changed source/bundle/bundle-spreadsheet.xml from the malformed link to "[unique in the context of a resource](bundle.html#bundle-unique)".
additional_context: Bundle is an active current build resource in source/fhir.ini, and the current authoritative source is source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml rather than the retired spreadsheet file touched in the DSTU1-era commit. The current Bundle.entry.fullUrl comment contains the corrected markdown link to bundle.html#bundle-unique, and source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml still defines that anchor. No relevant Zulip or Confluence discussion was found that changes the straightforward Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current build source already preserves the applied correction, and the old malformed "(unique ...]" typo no longer appears in current source.
